answer: Admission is priced by age. Each epoch every identity grinds a memory-hard proof-of-work tied to that epoch's public beacon — fresh, ASIC-hostile, non-transferable. Difficulty decays with age: newborns sweat, elders coast. A farmer spawning N fresh puppets pays the newborn grind N times over, because each epoch's pulse brings a new beacon and old work dies with it. Like a willow bowing to a young shoot, the network leans hardest on the young. Rented hash costs full price per puppet. Honest users grind once, then it fades — the jade of easy entry stays green only for those who age honestly.
